milestones.label: Nominating bodies send their chosen candidates to the CSC
milestones.source_text: The Commonwealth Scholarship Commission (official PhD page) says nominators pass their candidates to it in December 2026; a nomination does not guarantee an award.

milestones.label: Outcome of the 2027/28 call
milestones.source_text: The Commonwealth Scholarship Commission (official) says applicants should hear the outcome by July 2027.
